tasks.title: Wire and generalize the fail-closed graph-scoped regression gate
tasks.tests: python -m pytest -q taskplane/tests/test_regression_dod.py taskplane/tests/test_regression_gate.py taskplane/tests/test_dor_dod.py taskplane/tests/test_loop.py taskplane/tests/test_selfreview_fixes.py
criteria: Governed execute/fix, task DoD, and sign-off contracts enable regression_gate.
Python radius selection supports arbitrary package directories and visibly widens to all discovered tests when imports cannot prove a narrower set.
The active interpreter runs pytest; runner startup, collection, usage, interruption, and internal errors become named blockers.
A baseline-green/current-red test still produces an exact regression blocker, with existing classification behavior preserved.
acceptance_refs: Every governed execute/fix task and final sign-off enables the regression gate, and a was-green-now-red test blocks with baseline evidence.
A missing pytest module, collection error, or invalid runner invocation produces a regression_gate blocker rather than an empty failure set.
Python source and tests outside the taskplane/ package layout participate in Tier-1 radius selection, with a visible full-suite fallback when mapping is incomplete.

tasks.title: Adopt native Codex subagent dispatch identity, reasoning tiers, lifecycle hooks, and workflow guidance
tasks.tests: python -m pytest -q taskplane/tests/test_codex_compat.py taskplane/tests/test_v101_fixes.py taskplane/tests/test_stage_waves.py taskplane/tests/test_dispatch_parity.py
criteria: Briefs expose stable Codex task_name, taskPlane role identity, model and tier-derived reasoning_effort without provider model defaults.
Strict dispatch matches current spawn_agent-shaped task_name input and rejects role, model, or effort mismatch instead of accepting a missing expectation.
SubagentStart/SubagentStop trace lifecycle and add bounded contract context; PreToolUse and evidence gates remain the enforcement boundary.

Codex instructions explicitly spawn independent work concurrently, wait and collect, interrupt/escalate safely, preserve full role instructions, and recommend optional user-started /goal for long loops.
Claude Dynamic Workflow behavior and the byte-identical portable fallback remain available.
acceptance_refs: Codex dispatch briefs expose a valid stable task_name, role id, model, and reasoning_effort; strict dispatch rejects mismatched model or effort using current spawn_agent-shaped input.

Codex workflow guidance directs parallel spawn, wait, result collection, interruption, lifecycle tracing, and optional user-started Goal mode; Claude workflow files remain excluded from the OpenAI ZIP.

tasks.title: Close the OpenAI package and add target-host CI/onboarding truth
criteria: The OpenAI ZIP contains README and every docs path referenced by shipped skills/runtime; package validation and tests inspect archive membership, not only the repository.
Codex onboarding uses current /plugins guidance and host-neutral tests isolate CODEX_HOME deliberately.
CI runs an explicit CODEX_HOME compatibility leg and preserves the neutral Python matrix.
Guardrail copy matches the documented Codex hook coverage and exceptions.
acceptance_refs: Codex workflow guidance directs parallel spawn, wait, result collection, interruption, lifecycle tracing, and optional user-started Goal mode; Claude workflow files remain excluded from the OpenAI ZIP.
Every README/docs path referenced by a shipped skill or runtime file exists in the generated OpenAI ZIP.
A Codex-host CI leg passes, normal repository-root pytest collection succeeds, and staging directories are absent and ignored.

tasks.title: Remove analysis-polluting scratch, validate the complete release, and preserve 2.7.1 provenance
criteria: All four scratch roots are absent from the index and ignored for future local transfer/fix waves.
Repository-root pytest collection, canonical pytest, unittest discover/floor, cost ratchets, generated-doc drift, manifest verification, and deterministic OpenAI package validation pass.
All manifest versions resolve to the 2.7.1 patch release; release notes describe the hardening without claiming a new feature version.
Only after evidence and engineering review pass may the orchestrator create the release commit and v2.7.1 tag.
acceptance_refs: A Codex-host CI leg passes, normal repository-root pytest collection succeeds, and staging directories are absent and ignored.
The complete canonical suite and package validation pass before the release commit and v2.7.1 tag are created.
